question: 两本书「谁更值得开」这个差，有多少是窗口不同造成的？把两本放到同一段日历、同一把时钟、同一种成交口径上，差还在不在？

caliber.series: book_pair_blend.load_cb() / load_etf() -- the same two parent legs the book family uses
caliber.cb_execution: signal at close t, filled at close t+1
caliber.etf_execution: decide at close t, own from the open of t+1 (entry_lag=1)
caliber.ann_days_full_history: cb 244 / etf 252 (each face's own clock, as published)
caliber.same_window_base: the first shared bar's level is the entry level (no return before you could own it)
caliber.yearly: year = previous year-end level -> this year-end level; first year starts at the first shared bar
caliber.wallet: single book at a time; the rest of the 1,000,000 rolls at the cash leg; deployment caps come from results/cb_union_lens.json
caliber.what_this_face_does_not_do: it does not re-run either book's rules and it does not re-price anything; it slices two published daily series and restates them on one ruler

shared_window.why_not_the_full_cb_history: the etf book only has a level from 2020-01-03; before that there is no second book to compare

cb.label: 转债双低袖（20 名等权 / 20 日 / 10bp）

etf.label: ETF 复合书（去债档 + 8 个点波动目标 / 5 名 / 20 日 / 10bp）

published_etf_arm.note: close-to-close, entry_lag not recorded by the face

decomposition.identity: gap_b - gap_a == execution_effect_on_etf - window_effect_on_cb (the two biases are subtracted from the same gap)
decomposition.reading: two published numbers were each about a point too generous, for two different reasons: the convertible book was quoted on 19.3 years it alone had, the etf book was quoted close-to-close instead of next-open. The two effects nearly cancel in the gap, so the ranking published earlier was right -- but neither absolute number was

A.why_two_terms: the etf book only asks for 750475 of the 1,000,000; the other 240578 would have been in the convertible book had you picked that one, so it sits in the cash leg instead

B.why_two_terms: the etf book only asks for 750475 of the 1,000,000; the other 240578 would have been in the convertible book had you picked that one, so it sits in the cash leg instead

correlation.reading: two books that barely move together -- but a 1M wallet can only open one

sentence: 按各自整段历史（转债 2007-07-12 起、ETF 2020-01-03 起），ETF 年化 10.89%、转债 7.35%，差 +3.54 个百分点；把两本放到同一段日历（2020-01-03..2026-11-26）、同一把 244 天时钟、同一种次日成交，ETF 9.86%、转债 6.29%，差 +3.57 个百分点（比面世尺 +0.03）；100 万钱包里单开 ETF 年 76885 元、单开转债年 62478 元，差 14406 元（面世尺是 11626 元）。
known_gaps: the two books carry different universes, different cost models and different turnover; this face aligns dates and clocks, not mechanics
the etf book runs a volatility target (it de-levers), the cb book does not -- the gap in raw CAGR therefore mixes return with risk budget; the sharpe/maxdd columns are there to read it both ways
the cb book is quoted on 244 days and the etf face on 252; the full-history rows keep each face's own clock and are therefore not directly subtractable from each other
